title: SEC1: No observability for STARTTLS handshake success vs timeout
description: In lifecycle.rs run_plain_session, there is an info\! log when STARTTLS handshake is initiated (line 212: 'STARTTLS: performing TLS handshake') and a warn\! on failure (line 228). However there is no info\! or counter metric on handshake success. After run_session_post_starttls returns, the only log is the session-end log from run_plain_session (line 234). A production operator cannot distinguish these three cases from logs alone: (a) client sent STARTTLS, completed handshake, issued commands, quit normally; (b) client sent STARTTLS, completed handshake, then dropped; (c) client sent STARTTLS, 382 was sent, but client never completed the handshake (TCP half-open). Case (c) is a common misbehaving-client or TLS interception scenario. Without an explicit success log and/or a Prometheus counter for starttls_success/starttls_failure, diagnosing TLS upgrade problems in production requires pcap.
